name: Hot Air Balloon
desc: Single hero hot-air balloon drifting on incommensurate air currents — gored envelope, roaring burner flame that flickers and lifts, wicker basket swinging on its ropes with sandbags, and a slow highlight band breathing across the fabric. Styles: rainbow gores, sunset orange-gold, checkered, solid with white, and night-glow where the burner lights the whole envelope from inside.
